heroHeadline: Returns Decree-Law Stalls as Sumar Blocks It From Reaching the Council of Ministers
heroSubtitle: The decree-law to speed returns to Morocco of people who crossed into Ceuta since Jul 30 was absent from the Sep 29 Council of Ministers; Sumar says its ministers stopped it, while the PP accuses the government of lacking will and 12 NGOs warn of weakened asylum guarantees.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
